explanation: The canonical import of this attempt ABORTED because post-copy hash verification detected that tree-before.txt arrived as 186 space characters instead of its real 186 bytes of content. This is an NTFS lazy-write artifact of fs.cpSync reading allocated-but-unflushed data. The verification behaved exactly as intended: corrupted evidence was refused, not accepted.
remediation: This partial directory is preserved rather than deleted, because the contract forbids deleting canonical attempts and an aborted import must remain visible. importCanonical was changed to copy file-by-file with an explicit read, write, fsync and byte comparison instead of fs.cpSync. The focused campaign was then re-executed as a new attempt generation; only that generation is controlling.
contractBasis: R16_IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.md section 4 permits ADDING a recovery-adjudication file; existing files are never modified.
